admin.dashboard.title: Dashboard
admin.dashboard.areas_help: Each one does a single job.
guide.stories: Open a language edition, see where it sits, and move it.
guide.new: Start a draft in one language. The other edition is a separate step.
guide.media: Pictures for the lead and the body. A file in use cannot be deleted.
guide.homepage: Choose what leads this edition, and the label that sits above it.
guide.authors: Guest and agency bylines. Staff names come from their account.
guide.sections: The desks stories are filed under. Each language has its own name and slug.
guide.tags: Subjects on the public site. Merge two when they are the same subject.
guide.locales: Which languages can be published. This desk stays Arabic or English.
guide.roles: Custom jobs and what they may do. The five system roles stay fixed.
guide.settings: The public name, and whether a new reader can register.
guide.users: Staff and readers. A role can cover one desk or the whole newsroom.
guide.audit: Who did what, with the reason, in the order it happened.
guide.editor: Try formatting here. Nothing on this page is saved.
guide.yours: Jobs assigned to you. A desk limit means the job applies only there.
guide.permissions: Every action those jobs allow. Open the list when you need the codes.
guide.lead: The picture at the top of the public story.
guide.slug: The public address. Changing it keeps the old address working.
guide.edit: Headline, deck, and body. Autosave updates this draft for a few minutes.
guide.comments: Reader comments on this edition. Hide one here. There is no separate queue.
guide.correction: A note readers see on the published story. It does not rewrite the text.
guide.actions: Move this edition along the desk. Some steps need a reason.
guide.history: Saves and decisions, newest first. Restore copies an older save into a new one.
guide.translation: Another language of the same story. It has its own status and address.
error.403: You do not have access to this page.
error.500: Something went wrong on our side.
editor.title: Story editor
editor.intro: This is the editor writers and copy editors will use. Preview renders the document on the server. Nothing is saved yet.

desk.subtitle: Subtitle
desk.none_for_you: No workflow actions for your role.
desk.restored: Restored as a new revision. The live page is unchanged until you publish the update.
desk.slug_changed: Slug updated. The old address redirects here.
desk.corrected: Note added. Readers see it on the live page.

desk.held: Legal hold is on. This story cannot be scheduled or published.

desk.purge_warning: This permanently removes this language edition. The audit log keeps the slug, title, and reason.
manage.locales_help: A language is a row. The dashboard stays in Arabic or English until that interface has a catalog.
manage.roles_help: System roles stay as shipped. A custom role ranks below you and cannot be a second super admin.
manage.settings_help: The site name and whether readers can register. Mail and database credentials stay in the environment.
